title: Cross-implementation interoperability
description: Engineering consequence of the stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second. The reference-script clause was dropped on 2026-10-22 (owner's decision): WHO PR 129 removed generate_dvc_qr.py from the guide, and its certificates are already covered by the PR 129 vector (STT-TST-001).

statements.label: Cross-implementation interoperability
statements.requirement: Certificates issued by each library (ES256 and PS256) SHALL verify in the other library, and the two libraries SHALL build the same Sig_structure and COSE_Sign1 bytes from the same request and signature.

successCriteria.criterion: Certificates issued by each library with ES256 and PS256 verify in the other library, built from byte-identical Sig_structure and COSE_Sign1 bytes (tools/conformance-ts/cross.ts).
